digest.component_or_area: completion verifier orchestration and recovery workflow modules
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py exceed or meet the 800-LOC module-size CI cap, blocking further edits without architectural refactor

completion.py contains four distinct concerns (operation orchestration, child-closure gate, epic-bug screen, verdict reconciliation) that must be separated into distinct modules with clear contractual boundaries
completion_recovery.py contains three distinct concerns (criteria surface and admission bounds, failure taxonomy, recovery orchestration) that must be separated into dedicated modules

Four new modules (completion_child_gate.py, completion_reconcile.py, completion_criteria.py, completion_failures.py) must be created to absorb split concerns; epic_bug_screen.py must absorb the epic bug-screen DET layer from completion.py

All moved symbols must remain patchable at their dotted names and behavior-preserving; stable public seams via re-export from completion.py and completion_recovery.py must be maintained for backward-compatibility with existing tests and callers
Test import paths and monkeypatch targets must be updated to reflect new module locations; no assertion logic changes are permitted
